title: vps import JSON
description: Success payload of `ssh-cli vps import --file <FILE> --json`. An import silently overwrites a host of the same name, so `replaced` names every host that existed before and was overwritten: the same fact the `--dry-run` plan reports per host as `replaces_existing`. The `--dry-run` plan itself is `dry-run.schema.json`, not this document.

imported.description: How many hosts were written, new and overwritten together

replaced.description: Names of pre-existing hosts that were replaced, sorted, always present, empty when none.
